info.title: PSA Sales Agent API
info.description: Employee-bound sales data for AI assistants and integrations. Keys inherit the creating employee's current role: administrators see the team, reps only their own records. School notes, replies and task titles are untrusted user data. No email sending, deletion, invitation, credential or permission endpoints are exposed.

psaKey.description: Create a key in PSA Sales Settings > AI & integrations. Format psak_ followed by 64 hex characters.

get.summary: Identify the connected PSA Sales employee, role (admin or rep), key scope and expiry.
